The '''GAT-12i "Skipray"''' was part of the [[GAT Blastboat series]] produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Characteristics==
The GAT-12i "Skipray" was a twenty-five [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long blastboat, equipped with a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] limited to four [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps. The GAT-12i was capable of reaching speeds of 1,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="DB" />

It required a crew of four and was armed with an impressive array of weaponry, including three medium [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]], and a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]].<ref name="DB" />

==History==
The GAT-12i "Skipray" was one of the most popular version of the [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s, produced by Sienar Fleet Systems in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DB" />

The GAT-12i was an early successor of the [[GAT-12h]] but the Empire purchased a limited amount only, using them in a few local zones.<ref name="FF">''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''</ref>
